about: Every outside source levi.events depends on or borrows from: where it comes from, which version, under which licence, whether LEVI ships any of it and whether that may be redistributed. A source whose code licence is non-commercial, missing or unverified may only be used as an idea (use = adopt-idea), never copied or shipped. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md remains the release inventory; this file is the structured record for this package, checked by tests/test_events_third_party.py.

citation.authors: Jingyang Lin, Jialian Wu, Jiang Liu, Ximeng Sun, Ze Wang, Xiaodong Yu, Jiebo Luo, Zicheng Liu, Emad Barsoum
citation.title: VideoSeek: Long-Horizon Video Agent with Tool-Guided Seeking

components.notes: Its overview, skim and focus tools (look at the whole video, then at chosen stretches) named the evidence planner's tiers. VideoSeek is a question-driven agent that chooses where to look itself; LEVI's planner is a fixed, model-free rule over a frame budget. No code was read into or copied from the repository.

citation.authors: Yanjiang Guo, Haodong Yan, Zhide Zhong, Zhongru Zhang, Qingyuan Yang, Qingzhou Lu, Xiaoyu Chen, Yen-Jen Wang, Shuying Deng, Chenghan Yang, Puzhen Yuan, Chenxin Liu, Tun Ban, Xiang Zhu, Yichen Liu, Kun Feng, Haoang Li, Jianyu Chen
citation.title: Video Prediction Policy 2: Predict Better, Act Better

components.notes: Only two things are taken from the paper: clips of 1 to 12 seconds, and the two cheap physical cues named for cutting them (local minima of end-effector or hand velocity; moments the gripper or fingers open or close). Everything else in clips.py (how a minimum is found, its thresholds, where a boundary sits, how long and short clips are repaired) is ours: the paper does not give it, and ClipParams marks each parameter paper or ours. The result is not a reproduction of the paper's pipeline; the model refinement step is not implemented. Checked against the downloaded v1 text: the 18 authors and their order, the title, the arXiv number, the v1 date (2026-10-07), the cs.CV category, the two cues and the 1-12 s range. Not checked, so not recorded here: v4 (2026-10-26), the cs.RO cross-list, a DOI. No text, figure or code of the paper is copied.
